column1: # The pictures `just images` draws into docs/assets/images: name, source, flags, tab-separated.
# name    the picture, written as docs/assets/images/<name>.png
# source  a .scad file, drawn as it is; or a docs page, which draws the scad block just before
#         the page's image of that name, with the page's `// file:` blocks beside it. That block
#         must include the library and draw something.
# flags   OpenSCAD options for the picture; without them, a top view framed by --viewall at
# Every picture in docs/assets/images needs a row; `just docs-check` fails on one without.
# the reference pages: one drawing each, framed by --viewall
# the example sheets, on the README and the examples page; the camera frames the sheet itself
